02My Story
I Didn't Have Rich Parents

From a ₦2,000 Salon Job
to Retiring My Parents at 20

A few years ago, I was in deep poverty. When I finished secondary school, I didn't have money to send myself to school, so I stayed home for two years. I was depressed, watching my mates go to class while I sat at home.

So I got up and started doing odd jobs. I worked as a salon apprentice where they paid me ₦2,000. Not $2,000. ₦2,000. Then I went to learn nails, and they treated me like complete trash.

One day I was scrolling Instagram and saw a lady who earned $2,000 from ghostwriting. I loved writing, so I messaged her. She told me to bring ₦100k. I couldn't afford it.

So I swapped the XS Max my family bought me for my birthday for an iPhone 6, added some money, and paid for that training. Till today, my family doesn't know I sold that phone.

"That little but not so little decision changed my whole life."
1 MonthI started seeing changes.
2 MonthsI bought my phone back. An iPhone 14.
4 MonthsTwo iPhone 16s and my first trip out of Nigeria. Then trips upon trips, dollars upon dollars.
TodayFull relocation, a house for my parents in Ikoyi without debt, land properties, a Benz, and my parents retired, all at 20.
I Don't Just Teach It. I Live It.

03The Method
What Is Ghostwriting?

You Write for Foreign Companies.
They Pay You in Dollars.

This is not writing for one person who pays you small money. You write stories for big, rich foreign companies that are literally begging for writers to entertain their readers. One of them is owned by the same company behind TikTok.

Come to them the right way, which I'll teach you, and they offer you a contract. It's like getting a job that pays more than any government job, without leaving your bed.

How The Money Works

Two Types of Contracts

Exclusive

$1,000 – $2,000
  • Per contract
  • 1 story = 1 contract
  • Less common, but a huge jackpot
Best for beginners

Non-Exclusive

$300 – $500
  • Per contract
  • 1 story = multiple contracts
  • 10–15 companies can sign the same story

Same story, many companies, many payments. That's the strategy I teach.

Even If You've Never Written

How to Write a Good Story

1

Choose a genre

Romance, fiction, werewolf, whatever you like most.

2

Think of something juicy

Something that happened to you, a struggle, a past experience, or a movie that inspired you.

3

Break it down

Before, during and after the situation.

One idea ChatGPT gave me: "My best friend married my boyfriend, with a smile on my face. Everyone thought I was pretending not to cry. They were wrong." That one idea can earn $1,000 – $2,000.
Too busy to write?

Supervise and Still Get Paid

When I entered school, I was too busy to write, so I hired writers and supervised. I kept earning. The training shows you how to do the same.
